notes.title: Ver.2.4 Update: Graphics Boost & Smoother Gameplay!
notes.content:
This update brings a major visual upgrade while keeping the core gameplay intact. Here's what's new:

Enhanced effects using tessellation and more

Bone-based character animations (20 types: walk, idle, push, fall, etc.)

HDR support for richer visuals

Gamepad support for smoother control

Music originally made with SD-90 now reimagined using Cubase 14 Pro + HALion 7 + Groove Agent SE 5 + Simple Tank 4

Performance optimizations to reduce processing load

Anisotropic filtering enabled (no anti-aliasing)

Fixed character system removed — now fully bone-driven animation

Handy features like placement assist now selectable from settings

You can turn off effects to get a DirectX9-style look, but performance impact is minimal — so we recommend keeping them ON.

From Ver.2.2 to Ver.2.4, it's a big leap. Enjoy the upgrade!
